items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: I said, that's a seagull stomp. Yeah, you just pick up a number. You know, you went to pick up one number and pick up another number. That number ever could have been recorded. I think it would have been, went over big. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, well I think, but covered, but I could talk, I guess a couple

ctx.x: Well, I think we're about to run out a little bit now.

Well, let's not leave George McCollum out, Alvin Alcorn. See, as you talk, you think, you see? Think like George McCollum. George McCollum was a, he ain't number one trumpet man, but he was better when you put the music up there too. He was great. I remember one time in Basin, Mississippi, we was playing with Desdun, we was playing the advertisement.
